{{Top|leg|title=''Varda''-class starship}}
The '''''Varda''-class starship''' was a small model of [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]]. Considered antiquated and abandoned by the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kith Kark]] flew one before he joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
